packageRules.description: Auto-merge everything short of a major bump (digest, pin, patch, minor). These deploy via Portainer GitOps polling once merged. Majors and Plex are held back by the rules below, which must stay after this one to override it.
Group all LinuxServer.io images into one PR to reduce noise. Plex is excluded so it gets its own reviewable PR.

LinuxServer.io tags carry a per-build suffix (-lsNNN, plus a git hash on plex: 1.43.3.10896-<githash>-ls321, sonarr 4.0.19.2979-ls321). Renovate's default docker versioning only compares tags with a byte-identical suffix, so the changing rebuild counter made every newer tag look incompatible and these images were silently never offered an update. Loose versioning compares the numeric release parts and orders the -lsNNN counter numerically. Radarr is deliberately absent: it pins the plain upstream tag (6.3.0), which default docker versioning already handles. Add any image pinned to an -lsNNN-style tag here.

n8n publishes its beta line as plain semver too — `latest`/`stable` is 2.36.8 while `next`/`beta` is 2.37.4 — so plain version comparison would auto-merge us onto the beta channel. followTag makes Renovate propose whatever version the `stable` tag currently resolves to, which is what the previous `latest@sha256` pin effectively tracked.
Require manual review for major bumps (e.g. Radarr v5->v6, Postgres majors) which can need data migrations.

Plex is Renovate-managed but never auto-merged: the plex stack has no GitOps polling, so merging a bump only changes the repo and the new image needs a manual Pull and redeploy in Portainer. Review and merge the PR by hand, then redeploy.
